statements.statement: The patient presents with intermittent palpitations and exertional dyspnea
These symptoms are clinically consistent with the patient's known history of nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The patient has diagnosis codes I49.9 and I34.0
A 48-hour ambulatory electrocardiographic monitoring study was ordered
The procedure code is CPT code 93226
The service was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
This monitoring is medically necessary to correlate the patient's reported symptoms with any underlying cardiac arrhythmia
